title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site update
author: Ariana Patel
description: Motivation: provide first-party RAG templates and fully worked agent/tool-calling quickstarts so engineers can get started integrating retrieval-augmented generation with Redwood in under 10 minutes. This PR adds a set of opinionated RAG templates, three end-to-end agent examples that demonstrate tool-calling patterns (search, calendar, and ticketing), updated quickstart docs and sidebar entries on the docs site, and small improvements to the examples build/runtime harness. Checklist: 1) Add RAG templates and README with recommended prompt designs and chunking guidelines; 2) Add three agent/tool-calling quickstarts with sample code (Python + TypeScript) and test corpora; 3) Add docs site navigation entries and example gallery; 4) Add CI integration tests for the examples; 5) Update redwood-examples package.json and example launcher. Testing done: local smoke tests, examples unit tests in CI, and a manual run-through of each quickstart on a staging docs build. CI notes: initial CI run surfaced a flaky network-dependent test in examples/integrations/test_search_agent.py which was skipped and re-run; final CI passed all required checks. Rollout: docs will be live after merge with a small console banner linking to the new quickstarts; example code is published to the redwood-examples package and tagged v0.17.2. Related: closes ENG-845 and references PM-201 for product copy updates.
commits: 3 commits: 1) Add RAG templates and high-level README; 2) Add three agent quickstarts (search-agent, calendar-agent, ticketing-agent) and example datasets; 3) Docs site updates: sidebar, gallery entry, and small build tweaks.
